annotations.title: Check a routed KiCad board against datasheet layout rules

description: Measure a routed KiCad board (.kicad_pcb text, KiCad 6 or later) against layout rules YOU give, taken from each part's datasheet: decoupling (nearest supply-to-ground capacitor to a supply pad, centre to centre), thermal_vias (vias inside a pad's outline on its net), keepouts (tracks, vias, pads and zone outlines inside an area around a part or a rectangle), differential_pairs (routed length of each net, skew, width changes, via counts), track_widths (narrowest track on a net) and pad_geometry (a footprint's pad sizes against the datasheet's recommended land). The tool has NO rules or limits of its own: every limit is your number and the measured value is returned beside it. It does NOT measure impedance, copper inside zone fills, or anything you did not ask for; these are listed in not_measured. A rule that cannot be evaluated (part or net not on the board) is not_checkable, never a pass. Free with a DatasheetVend API key (no credits), no model call, reads no account data, stores nothing.

kicad_pcb.description: The whole .kicad_pcb file as text. It starts with '(kicad_pcb'.

rules.description: The rules to check. Give at least one.

ground_net.description: Net name exactly as the board names it, for example '+3V3'.

max_distance_mm.description: The farthest the capacitor may be, in millimetres

net.description: Net name exactly as the board names it, for example '+3V3'.

pad.description: One pad of the part. Without it every pad of the part on `net`.

ref.description: Reference designator on the board, for example 'U3'.

max_skew_mm.description: The largest length difference allowed, mm.

net_n.description: Net name exactly as the board names it, for example '+3V3'.

net_p.description: Net name exactly as the board names it, for example '+3V3'.

area.description: A rectangle in board coordinates, mm.

layers.description: Copper layers to test, for example ['F.Cu']. Without it every copper layer.

margin_mm.description: Grow the box of the part's pads by this much.

ref.description: Reference designator on the board, for example 'U3'.

ignore_pads.description: Pads the rule does not cover, such as an exposed pad.
